shadows.name: surface-ambient
shadows.purpose: Reinforces a large reusable surface when tonal separation is insufficient.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single high-emphasis action in a task region.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; min-height:2.75rem; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:.5rem; border:0; border-radius:.75rem; background:var(--blue); color:var(--text); padding:.625rem 1rem; font:600 .875rem/1.25 var(--font-source-sans-pro),Arial,sans-serif; transition:background 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:var(--blue-bright); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #60a5fa; outline-offset:4px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background:var(--blue-soft); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Supporting action that remains subordinate to the blue primary.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display:inline-flex; min-height:2.75rem; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:.5rem; border:1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / .1); border-radius:.75rem; background:transparent; color:rgb(226 232 240); padding:.625rem 1rem; font:600 .875rem/1.25 var(--font-source-sans-pro),Arial,sans-serif; transition:background 160ms ease,color 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background:rgb(255 255 255 / .05); color:#fff; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #60a5fa; outline-offset:4px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { background:rgb(255 255 255 / .08); }

components.name: Field
components.description: Quiet dark input for search constraints, notes and account data.
components.css: .ds-field { display:grid; gap:.5rem; color:rgb(148 163 184); font:500 .75rem/1.25 var(--font-source-sans-pro),Arial,sans-serif; } .ds-field input { min-height:2.75rem; width:100%; border:1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / .08); border-radius:.75rem; background:rgb(255 255 255 / .035); color:#fff; padding:0 .75rem; font:400 .875rem/1.5 var(--font-source-sans-pro),Arial,sans-serif; outline:none; } .ds-field input:hover { border-color:rgb(255 255 255 / .14); } .ds-field input:focus-visible { border-color:rgb(147 197 253 / .45); box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgb(59 130 246 / .18); }

components.name: Primary Navigation
components.description: Persistent three-destination operating navigation with one active state.
components.html: <nav class="ds-nav" aria-label="Primary"><button class="ds-nav-item ds-nav-active" aria-current="page">Find a Deal</button><button class="ds-nav-item">Scanner</button><button class="ds-nav-item">Saved Deals</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-nav { display:grid; gap:.25rem; width:232px; padding:1rem; background:#04070d; } .ds-nav-item { min-height:3rem; border:0; border-radius:.75rem; background:transparent; color:rgb(148 163 184); padding:0 .75rem; text-align:left; font:500 .875rem/1.25 var(--font-source-sans-pro),Arial,sans-serif; transition:background 160ms ease,color 160ms ease; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background:rgb(255 255 255 / .04); color:#fff; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #60a5fa; outline-offset:2px; } .ds-nav-active { background:rgb(59 130 246 / .12); color:rgb(219 234 254); box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(147 197 253 / .15); }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Compact account, filter or unlocked-status context.
components.css: .ds-chip { display:inline-flex; min-height:2.5rem; align-items:center; gap:.5rem; border:1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / .08); border-radius:.75rem; background:rgb(255 255 255 / .025); color:rgb(203 213 225); padding:.5rem .75rem; font:400 .875rem/1.25 var(--font-source-sans-pro),Arial,sans-serif; transition:background 160ms ease,color 160ms ease; } .ds-chip:hover { background:rgb(255 255 255 / .05); color:#fff; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #60a5fa; outline-offset:4px; } .ds-chip:active { background:rgb(59 130 246 / .12); color:rgb(219 234 254); }

components.name: Deal Inspection Sheet
components.description: Full-height evidence layer opened from any deal source.
components.html:
Deal inspection

Resale evidence

Comparable sales, valuation reasoning and risk remain in one reading flow.
components.css: .ds-sheet { width:min(100%,660px); min-height:420px; border-left:1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / .09); background:#050810; color:#fff; box-shadow:-24px 0 70px rgba(0,0,0,.45); font-family:var(--font-source-sans-pro),Arial,sans-serif; } .ds-sheet header { min-height:4rem; display:flex; align-items:center; border-bottom:1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / .08); padding:0 1.25rem; font-weight:600; } .ds-sheet section { padding:1.75rem; } .ds-sheet h3 { margin:0; font-size:1.25rem; } .ds-sheet p { color:rgb(148 163 184); font-size:.875rem; line-height:1.5; } .ds-sheet footer { display:flex; gap:.75rem; border-top:1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / .08); padding:1rem 1.75rem; } .ds-sheet footer button { min-height:2.75rem; flex:1; border-radius:.75rem; padding:.625rem 1rem; font-weight:600; } .ds-sheet-primary { border:0; background:#246bfd; color:#fff; } .ds-sheet-primary:hover { background:#4c8dff; } .ds-sheet-secondary { border:1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / .1); background:transparent; color:rgb(226 232 240); } .ds-sheet-secondary:hover { background:rgb(255 255 255 / .05); color:#fff; } .ds-sheet footer button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #60a5fa; outline-offset:4px; }

narrative.overview:
Flipbot behaves like a focused operating desk for resale decisions: dark, calm and information-dense, with enough visual structure to compare opportunities quickly. Near-black navy layers reduce glare and make product imagery, prices and evidence carry the screen. Electric blue is deliberately scarce; it identifies active navigation, primary actions and interactive evidence rather than decorating empty space.

The system is desktop-first without treating mobile as a reduced product. Desktop uses a persistent rail and broad comparison canvas; mobile converts the same three primary destinations into a reachable bottom bar and stacks evidence without removing it. Representative or provisional information is labelled in context, and valuation confidence is communicated with words and evidence rather than colour alone.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black navy surfaces separated by cool, low-contrast borders.
Restrained electric-blue accents reserved for action and selection.
Compact, evidence-heavy deal cards with product imagery and tabular figures.
Progressive disclosure for advanced filters, account tools and deal detail.
Responsive navigation that preserves Find a Deal, Scanner and Saved Deals as peers.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Blue is the shared language of primary action, selection and active navigation; keep it rare enough that those states remain unmistakable.

rules.name: The Evidence Before Colour Rule
rules.body: Semantic colour reinforces a written value or state and never carries meaning alone.

rules.name: The Comparison First Rule
rules.body: Prices, profit, ROI and credit balances use tabular numerals so columns do not shift while values change.

rules.name: The Quiet Metadata Rule
rules.body: Small type is reserved for short labels and metadata; explanations remain at body size with generous leading.

rules.name: The Preserve the Evidence Rule
rules.body: Responsive layouts reflow controls and comparisons; they do not hide valuation evidence or demote a primary destination.

rules.name: The Flat Until Floating Rule
rules.body: In-flow cards use border and tone at rest; strong shadows belong only to elements that genuinely float above or slide over the workspace.

rules.name: The Nested Radius Rule
rules.body: Inner controls use a tighter radius than their parent surface, preserving a clear container hierarchy.

dos: Do lead operational surfaces toward one clear next action, using Signal Blue for that action.
Do keep representative, estimated, locked or prototype information labelled beside the affected content.
Do use tabular numerals and stable metric order for price, resale, profit and ROI comparisons.
Do preserve keyboard focus, reduced-motion behavior and text labels alongside icons.
Do keep Find a Deal, Scanner and Saved Deals as the primary navigation set across viewport sizes.
donts: Don't use blue as ambient decoration across every card; its scarcity establishes hierarchy.
Don't replace evidence with a score, colour or optimistic claim.
Don't add permanent primary-navigation destinations for account utilities or future product areas.
Don't hide financial or risk evidence merely to make mobile cards shorter.
Don't introduce bright white panels, glass-heavy effects or warm decorative palettes into the operating workspace.
